title: Fynaptix · Nuclear & SMR Research
heading: Nuclear Energy Intelligence
subheading: Small modular reactors, uranium & the AI power-demand trade
disclaimer: Not financial advice. This page organizes public information for research purposes only — not a recommendation to buy or sell any security. SMR developers are pre-revenue with long regulatory timelines; verify current prices and do your own due diligence before investing.

kpis.label: Expected US grid investment to match AI-driven electricity demand growth; hyperscalers hold 13+ nuclear deals totaling ~10 GW (Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Meta) — Meta alone accounts for ~6.6 GW across TerraPower, Oklo, Vistra and Constellation deals

TradeTech's U3O8 indicator is holding near a 6-month high; Kazatomprom pushed back its TQZ sulphuric-acid plant commissioning to Q3 2027-Q1 2028 (from Q1 2027) after a paleontological find halted construction, prolonging reliance on external reagent supply; long-term contract price still anchored near $94/lb

Shares pulled back with the broader sector on rising Treasury yields, but Brookfield/Cameco's 49%-owned Westinghouse confidentially filed for a US IPO targeting a ~$30B valuation — a potential major value-unlock catalyst for Cameco's stake

NRC's Clinch River (TVA/BWRX-300) construction-permit review continues toward a targeted December 2026 decision; OPG's Darlington BWRX-300 remains the nearest concrete build, targeting completion by end-2029 and commercial operation by end-2030. Oklo's DOE-authorized Groves reactor (Aug 25) is a non-power test unit, a different category from a licensed commercial SMR

rows.angle: Largest US nuclear fleet operator (55 GW post-Calpine); direct data-center PPAs with Microsoft, Meta, Walmart
rows.watch for: Shares ~$275 (Sept 3), softer this week on sector-wide de-risking from rising Treasury yields even as fundamentals improved: a Sept 2 FERC waiver keeps the Crane Clean Energy Center restart on track for 2027 and shares rose 3.17% on the news; guidance still $11.50-$12.50 adjusted EPS, reaffirmed; PPAs with Microsoft, Meta, Walmart, CyrusOne keep converting to guidance raises rather than just headlines

rows.angle: Major Western uranium producer + Westinghouse stake
rows.watch for: Shares ~$102.51, -5% trailing week on the broader sector pullback; but Brookfield/Cameco's 49%-owned Westinghouse confidentially filed for a US IPO targeting a ~$30B valuation — a potential major catalyst for Cameco's stake; 2026 production guidance held at 19.5-21.5M lb U3O8 despite a Key Lake/McArthur River flooding disruption and brief Cigar Lake pause, both now resolved; Cigar Lake ownership raised to 57.418% after the TEPCO stake closed (Jul 2)

rows.angle: Nuclear components, naval reactors, advanced reactor work
rows.watch for: Shares $172.40 (+2.21% intraday), up ~13% trailing week continuing to build on the Aug 26 Janus microreactor win at Fort Campbell — the Army's Janus program paired 5 reactor developers, BWXT among them, with different installations; FY26 revenue guide still ~$3.8B; Nordic Capital medical-business sale pending

rows.angle: Grid equipment + BWRX-300 SMR design via GE Hitachi Nuclear Energy
rows.watch for: Shares roughly flat at ~$942-948 trailing week; Aug 13 agreement with Blue Energy launches the next phase of a 2.5GW gas-plus-nuclear plant in Texas, layering up to five GVH SMRs (1.5GW) onto an initial 1GW gas-turbine phase from 2032; nuclear is just 2.6% of GEV revenue today but SMR contracts could drive ~$2B/year steady-state nuclear revenue from 2026 onward — earnings conversion remains the open question

rows.angle: Fast reactors using recycled waste; Sam Altman-backed; deals directly with AI/data-center customers
rows.watch for: PJM dropped Oklo's 750MW Meta-backed Pike County, Ohio interconnection project (150MW nuclear/300MW fuel cells/300MW gas) from its streamlined study queue Sept 1 over disputed inverter ride-through test data; Oklo filed an emergency FERC complaint Aug 28 warning of a 14-month delay and higher costs, with PJM's response due Sept 4. Shares sank to ~$38.46 on the news (down ~43% YTD) before a technical rebound to ~$40-41; the Aug 25 Groves Isotope Test Reactor authorization remains a non-power test milestone, not commercial revenue

rows.angle: Only SMR design with NRC formal approval; utility-focused; 6-8 GW TVA/ENTRA1 partnership under discussion
rows.watch for: Shares ~$9.61 (Sept 4), notably resilient through this week's Oklo-driven SMR selloff; CFO has guided investors to expect a PPA on the flagship 6GW project by year-end 2026, which would clear the path to construction; but Sept 4 coverage flags real dilution risk from the $1B ATM program completed in June, and NuScale still wouldn't own the reactors in the TVA/ENTRA1 structure — last week's ownership/revenue-capture question remains unresolved

rows.angle: HALEU enrichment — fuel for advanced reactors
rows.watch for: Shares fell to ~$170-171, down ~12% trailing week and ~28% YTD, as Northland cut its Q4 EPS estimate to $0.67 from $0.77; the new X-energy LEU/HALEU supply deal and DOE's $900M Piketon task order are genuine wins, but the stock keeps re-rating lower near 59x forward earnings on the still-unresolved Piketon cost overruns behind Q1's 63.2% YoY income decline

private_watchlist.name: TerraPower
private_watchlist.note: No material update this week beyond the Aug 14 Hyundai E&C EPC agreement (up to 8 Natrium reactors with completion/price/performance guarantees) and the SK Innovation term sheet for Korea's first commercial Natrium plant. Kemmerer Unit 1 (WY) construction, formally started Apr 23, continues toward operation ~2031, part of Meta's ~6.6 GW nuclear commitment.

private_watchlist.name: X-energy
private_watchlist.note: IPO'd Apr 24, 2026 at $23/share (Nasdaq: XE), first-day close $29.20 (+27%); shares have since pulled back to ~$18.15 (Sept 2). H1 2026 revenue+grants reached $98.0M (+132% YoY) on $90.0M of services revenue. DOE confirmed an additional $1B in ARDP cost-share for Long Mott (total $2.115B). Signed a definitive LEU/HALEU supply and prepayment agreement with Centrus (early Aug) to help secure fuel for its initial Xe-100 units. Liquidity remains strong with no debt.

private_watchlist.name: Kairos Power
private_watchlist.note: Google's first-ever corporate agreement to develop a US SMR fleet — up to 500 MW across 6-7 units; first commercial Hermes unit targeted for 2030, full fleet by 2035. Hermes 2 demonstration plant (Oak Ridge), which broke ground in April 2026, continues construction.

private_watchlist.name: Commonwealth Fusion
private_watchlist.note: SPARC demonstration machine in Devens, MA is now ~80% complete per CEO Bob Mumgaard, targeting a scientific-breakeven (Q>1) milestone sometime in 2027; filed a PJM interconnection request (Apr 28) as part of its commercial-scale development plan. Total raised now $3.94B after the $1B round that closed Jul 30.

private_watchlist.name: Helion
private_watchlist.note: OpenAI is reportedly in talks to buy power from Helion — potentially up to 5GW by 2030 and 50GW by 2035 — a possible second major AI-compute customer alongside the existing Microsoft PPA (50MW by 2029 via the Orion plant, under construction). Polaris prototype demonstrated D-T fusion at 150M°C plasma temperature (Aug 20). $465M Series G (June 2026) valued the company at $15.5B.

private_watchlist.name: Holtec Nuclear
private_watchlist.note: S-1/A amendment advances the ~$2.0B Nasdaq IPO (JPM, Guggenheim, Goldman, Citi, BofA leading); Sept 2 Motley Fool coverage frames Holtec as a fresh competitive threat to Oklo/NuScale in the SMR-300 microreactor space, citing its existing $989M revenue base and the DOE-backed Palisades restart (up to $1.5B loan guarantee) as an operating anchor most pre-revenue peers lack. Share count/price range still not set.

bear_case.title: A federal interconnection fight just hit a Tier 2 SMR name where it actually operates
bear_case.description: PJM's Sept 1 removal of Oklo's 750MW Meta-backed Ohio project from its study queue — over a disputed inverter ride-through data gap — is exactly the kind of grid-bureaucracy risk that pre-revenue SMR developers face well before reactor technology risk ever comes into play. Oklo's own FERC filing warns of a 14-month delay and higher costs; shares fell to ~$38.46 before a partial rebound, still down ~43% YTD.

bear_case.title: NuScale's dilution math still isn't settled
bear_case.description: The $1B ATM stock-sale program completed in June 2026 funds commercialization, but it also means today's Wall Street-implied upside is diluted before it's realized — Sept 4 coverage flags the risk explicitly even as the stock proved resilient through this week's broader SMR selloff. The CFO's year-end PPA guidance on the 6GW TVA/ENTRA1 project remains non-binding, and NuScale still wouldn't own the reactors in that structure.

bear_case.title: Centrus keeps re-rating lower despite a genuinely improving deal book
bear_case.description: Shares are down ~28% YTD and fell another ~12% this week to ~$170 even after the X-energy LEU/HALEU supply deal and DOE's $900M Piketon task order — Northland's Q4 EPS estimate cut to $0.67 from $0.77 shows the market still isn't convinced the underlying cost overruns are fixed, and the stock trades near 59x forward earnings on that unresolved question.

bear_case.title: Rising yields are compressing every long-duration nuclear growth story at once
bear_case.description: This week's sector-wide pullback (URA and URNM both down roughly 5-6% off last week's levels) hit CEG, CCJ and GEV even where company-specific news was neutral-to-positive (Crane FERC waiver, Westinghouse IPO filing) — a reminder that the nuclear-as-AI-power trade is still a rate-sensitive, multi-year-payback story, not a name-picker's shield against macro repricing.

catalysts.title: NuScale barely budges through Oklo-driven SMR selloff; dilution risk flagged
catalysts.description: While Oklo's PJM setback rattled the sector, NuScale shares held near $9.61 as the CFO reiterated guidance for a PPA on the flagship 6GW TVA/ENTRA1 project by year-end 2026. Same-day coverage flagged that the $1B ATM program completed in June creates real dilution risk even as consensus price targets imply meaningful upside.

catalysts.title: Constellation Energy rises 3.17% on FERC waiver keeping Crane restart on 2027 track
catalysts.description: Constellation Energy outpaced the broader Utilities sector after a Federal Energy Regulatory Commission waiver kept the Crane Clean Energy Center restart on track for 2027, reinforcing a guidance backdrop already raised to $11.50-$12.50 adjusted EPS on new nuclear PPAs including Walmart.

catalysts.title: Holtec Nuclear's IPO filing draws "new rival" framing against Oklo and NuScale
catalysts.description: Motley Fool coverage of Holtec Nuclear's advancing ~$2.0B Nasdaq IPO (ticker HNUC) framed the spent-fuel and SMR-300 incumbent as a fresh competitive threat to pre-revenue peers, noting Holtec already books $989M in annual revenue and holds a DOE loan guarantee for the Palisades restart — an operating anchor most SMR developers lack.

catalysts.title: PJM drops Oklo's Meta-backed Ohio project from interconnection queue; Oklo files FERC complaint
catalysts.description: PJM removed Oklo's 750MW Pike County, Ohio hybrid project from its streamlined interconnection study cycle over disputed inverter ride-through test data. Oklo filed an emergency FERC complaint Aug 28 seeking reinstatement and warning of a 14-month delay and higher costs; shares sank to ~$38.46 (down ~43% YTD) before a partial rebound.

catalysts.title: Westinghouse (Cameco 49% / Brookfield 51%) confidentially files for a ~$30B US IPO
catalysts.description: Brookfield and Cameco's jointly owned Westinghouse Electric confidentially filed for a US IPO, with reporting pointing to a potential valuation approaching $30B — a possible major value-unlock catalyst for Cameco's 49% stake, though share count, price range and timing remain undetermined.

catalysts.title: Kazatomprom pushes TQZ sulphuric-acid plant commissioning back to Q3 2027-Q1 2028
catalysts.description: Kazatomprom disclosed that a paleontological find during earthworks halted construction at its TQZ sulphuric-acid plant, pushing commissioning back six to twelve months from a prior Q1 2027 target and prolonging reliance on external reagent supply for its in-situ recovery operations — another data point in a tightening uranium supply picture alongside Niger permit shifts.
